title: Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA6 Collector Set Without the Game
description: Rockstar Games has announced a £349 limited Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA6, available for pre-order now without a game copy.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Unveils £350 GTA6 Collector Set Without the Game

As the anticipation for the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to build worldwide, Rockstar Games has kicked off its merchandise rollout with a statement piece. According to reports from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, Rockstar has revealed a limited edition "Goodtime State Vice City" collection of goodies for GTA6, carrying a hefty price tag of **£349**.

### Premium Price Tag and No Game Included

The newly announced collection has immediately grabbed the attention of the gaming community, not just for its thematic design tied to the iconic Vice City setting, but also for its pricing structure. Notably, the £349 package **does not include a copy of the game itself**. Players who choose to purchase this premium bundle will still need to acquire the game separately upon its release.

While details on the exact contents of the box lean into the provocative and wild aesthetic expected from the franchise, Eurogamer notes that the collection features items you "definitely wouldn't get through airport security." The playful yet edgy nature of the gear fits right into the chaotic atmosphere that fans associate with the Grand Theft Auto universe.

### Pre-orders Open Now

For die-hard fans and dedicated collectors looking to grab a piece of GTA history ahead of launch, the Goodtime State Vice City collection is available for pre-order now. Given Rockstar's track record with limited-run merchandise, these high-end collector items are expected to draw significant attention from enthusiasts.

Whether this luxury bundle will appeal to the broader player base given its price and lack of software remains to be seen, but it undoubtedly highlights the massive cultural footprint and marketing power behind the upcoming title.

## Editor's Take

A £350 price tag for a collector's box that doesn't even include the game is a bold move by Rockstar, squarely targeting the most dedicated collectors. While the unique Vice City items are undeniably cool, casual fans might want to save their cash for the actual game. If you have the budget and love collecting high-end swag, it's a fun piece of history; otherwise, it's an easy pass.
